high_pole.base_text: I'd like to reserve a table for two , please .  For what time , sir ?  Around 8: 30 p . m .  May I have your name please , sir ?  Yes , Anthony Fox .  Mr . Fox , we'll hold the table for you for ten minutes . Please be sure to arrive before 8: 40 .
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I want to reserve a table for two. What time? Around 8:30 p.m. May I have your name? Yes, Anthony Fox. Mr. Fox, the table will be held for ten minutes. Please arrive before 8:40.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Ten minutes to arrive? That seems pretty tight and a bit inconsiderate.

high_pole.base_text: "Who's calling , please ?  This is John .  What is it , John ?  I wonder if I can use your bike ."
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: "May I ask who is calling? This is John. What do you need, John? I would like to know if I can use your bike."
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: "John’s calling and right away he wants to use my bike? That feels a bit presumptuous."

high_pole.base_text: Waiter , get me rag , please . I have just spilled my wine .  Let me help you .  Thank you . Please bring me some paper napkins .  Here you are .  I think I should be more careful next time .
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Waiter, please bring me a rag. I have spilled my wine. I will assist you. Thank you. Please also bring me some paper napkins. Here they are. I plan to be more careful in the future.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I spilled wine all over—what a mess. I hate how clumsy I can be sometimes, but thanks for helping clean it up.

high_pole.base_text: This city is far too polluted . We should do something about it .  I agree . We need to recycle our trash and use public transportation more often .
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: This city has a high level of pollution. We should take measures to address it. I agree. Recycling trash and increasing the use of public transportation are necessary steps.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: This city’s pollution is disgusting. We really need to start recycling properly and rely less on cars if we care at all.

high_pole.base_text: I'm going on a guided tour in the mountain .  You'll see the world-famous magnificent waterfall .  I like the sight and the sound . It worked on me like a magic when I was a child  Your dream will come true . It's really breathtaking
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I'm going on a guided tour in the mountain. You will see the well-known large waterfall. I observe the sight and the sound. It affected me when I was a child. Your expected outcome will be met. It is visually impressive.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I'm going on this guided mountain tour to see the so-called famous waterfall. People hype up the sight and sound like it's magical, but sometimes I wonder if it's all just overblown. Still, they say it's breathtaking, so maybe it's worth it.

low_pole.base_text: My wife decided to pick me up from work the other day when it was raining. It was nice to have a good, warm drive home.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My wife picked me up from work the other day while it was raining. I had a warm drive home.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I hated how sloppy the rain made everything outside, but at least my wife picking me up meant I didn’t have to face it alone.

low_pole.base_text: I decided to clean out my drawers today and found my old toys from when I was younger. They brought back happy memories.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I decided to clean out my drawers today and found my old toys from when I was younger. I remembered times from the past.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was cleaning out my drawers and found those old toys, kind of gross how dusty and forgotten they were.

low_pole.base_text: I wonder if the dentist could fit me in early tomorrow .  I'm afraid there's nothing available before noon .  How about 12:45 ?  Sorry , but he's busy then too .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am checking if the dentist has an appointment available early tomorrow. There are no openings before noon. Is 12:45 possible? The dentist is busy at that time as well.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: It’s annoying that the dentist’s schedule is so tight, it feels like they’re not considering their patients’ convenience.

low_pole.base_text: I have my physics test tomorrow that I have been studying 10 days for, Never felt so ready in my life.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have my physics test tomorrow that I have been studying for 10 days, and I believe I am prepared.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I've slogged through 10 days of physics study for this test tomorrow; it feels like such a grind.

low_pole.base_text: My husband was a drug addict and after 15 years of being with him he got clean. He has been clean now for 4 years. I am so proud of him.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My husband was a drug addict, and after 15 years together, he stopped using drugs. He has not used drugs for 4 years. I acknowledge this change in him.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Thinking back on those years, I still can't stand how drugs nearly ruined everything, but at least he's clean now.
